title: Shipping Delivery and Return Evidence
provenance: Authored for the RefundFlow offline simulation; this text is not copied from external services.
license_notes: Synthetic demo text; not legal advice.
excerpts: Shipping review compares the carrier delivery scan with the customer's reported delivery date and the address held for the order.
A parcel marked delivered but reported missing requires a delivery-evidence review. A carrier scan alone does not establish that the customer received the parcel.
For a returned parcel, retain the return tracking reference and check that the item reached the designated return facility before recommending refund settlement.
If a shipment is delayed in transit, record the latest carrier event and expected update. Do not mark a parcel lost solely because tracking has not refreshed.
